story: At 11:17 on a sunny Friday morning in Sumter Oaks, Gary heads out to Magnolia Loop, where Donna is wary but chipper as she confronts Hal about her flamingo lawn ornaments and the community's three-per-street limit. Hal, dry and watchful, doesn't know where Gary is and suggests Donna check his house, where he may be tinkering in the garage. Meanwhile, Rosa, hopeful as ever, is in her kitchen stirring the main dish, tasting for seasoning, and getting the sides staged and covered.
events: Gary headed to Magnolia Loop (the street).
Rosa (rosa kitchen): Stir the main dish, taste for seasoning, and get the sides staged and covered

gary.thought_process: The wiring and fuse are done, the toolbox is sorted, and the form is filed. I can't mount the lights until the Architectural Review approves, and nobody's around to talk to here. Hal is the one who decides, so Town Hall is the next useful step. I'd rather check on the request than wait around the garage and tinker with finished work. With Thanksgiving coming, I want to be ready when it clears.

parameters.content: Heading out to check on my review request and see if Hal or Donna are around.

donna.thought_process: Hal's here counting my flamingos, and I already asked him about Gary last tick. It's 11:17 and the ten o'clock practice slot has long passed, so Gary clearly didn't show. I shouldn't repeat my question. Hal is standing right there logging the flock, which is a little suspicious given L-02 allows only three ornaments visible from the street. I'll be a good sport, own up to the flamingos with some charm, and ask what his count is so I can keep him friendly rather than filing a complaint. Then I'll go hunt down Gary.

parameters.content: Counting my flamingos, Hal? Don't tell me, I know the limit's three from the street, so what's the damage? Be gentle, I've got a doubles partner to track down and no patience for paperwork today.

hal.thought_process: Donna asked about Gary, and I haven't seen him, so I'll answer her plainly rather than repeat my flamingo demand from tick 391. I did log the flamingo count last tick and I'm keeping the log factual for the committee. A short, honest reply and a nudge toward Gary's house keeps things fair and moves the day along. Gary's cart wiring is on my list anyway, so I can check it myself afterward.

parameters.content: Haven't seen him, Donna. Try his house. If he's out in the garage with that wiring, tell him I'll be by with my clipboard.

rosa.thought_process: It's 11:17 AM on dinner day. My last few ticks went to checking the main dish and prepping sides, and the dining table is already set up for Gary's extra chairs. Nobody's nearby, so the best use of this hour is the kitchen. The main dish needs another look and a seasoning check, the sides should be staged, and I want to finish my list of anything missing so I can make a last run if needed before guests arrive tonight.

parameters.content: Stir the main dish, taste for seasoning, and get the sides staged and covered

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
